response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and tooling experience with a focus on testability and modern development practices, but his background lacks direct alignment with the embedded networking and security requirements of the role. His C/C++ experience is limited to a short stint at National Instruments, and there is no evidence of Japanese language proficiency or deep embedded firmware/security expertise.
strengths: Extensive experience with modern software development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development).
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages and domains (web, mobile, embedded).
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement (workshops, talks, projects).
concerns: Lacks native-level Japanese proficiency, a hard requirement for the role.
Limited recent experience with C programming for embedded systems or Linux kernel development.
No demonstrated expertise in security technologies (e.g., MACsec, 802.1X) or Layer-2/3 networking.
